name: Memory Context - Zero-Shift Context Engine
description: The ultimate context preservation system. Guarantees zero context shifting, zero compaction, and 100% context retention via JIT hierarchical assembly. Features: Shift-Proof Architecture, Infinite Context Windows, Predictive Layer Management, and Quantum-Stable Context Anchors.

mode.description: Context assembly mode: JIT (recommended), adaptive, or strict preservation

hierarchyLevels.description: Number of context hierarchy levels (L0-L4 default)

enableShiftImmunity.description: Enable context shift immunity - guarantees no context loss during model swaps

enablePredictiveAssembly.description: Pre-assemble likely next contexts based on conversation patterns

enableQuantumAnchors.description: Use quantum-stable anchors for context continuity

retentionPolicy.description: How to handle context growth: infinite (no limits), bounded (max layers), circular (replace oldest)

compactionMode.description: Compaction is disabled - JIT rebuilds from full source every time

autoDetectModel.description: Automatically detect model and configure context window

semanticWeight.description: Weight for semantic vs token-based context selection

workingMemorySize.description: Number of recent interactions in working memory (L0)

enableHeuristicScoring.description: Use advanced heuristics for content scoring and relevance

enableContextDiff.description: Track and report what changed between context builds

persistFullHistory.description: Persist complete conversation history (required for JIT rebuilding)

mode.label: Assembly Mode
mode.description: JIT mode rebuilds context fresh every time - zero compaction needed

retentionPolicy.label: Retention Policy
retentionPolicy.description: Infinite = keep everything, rebuild on demand

compactionMode.label: Compaction
compactionMode.description: Always disabled - JIT doesn't need compaction
